verses.text: The word of Nehemiah, the son of Hachaliah.
One of my brethren, Hanani, came with certain men from Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

And they said unto me, “The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach; the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.”
And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven, and said,
“I beseech Thee, O Lord God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love Him and observe His commandments,

Let Thine ear now be attentive, and Thine eyes open, that Thou mayest hear the prayer of Thy servant, which I pray before Thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel Thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against Thee; both I and my father's house have sinned.
We have dealt very corruptly against Thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which Thou commandedst Thy servant Moses.
“Remember, I beseech Thee, the word that Thou commandedst Thy servant Moses, saying, ‘If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations;

But if ye turn unto Me, and keep My commandments, and do them, though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set My name there.’
“Now these are Thy servants and Thy people, whom Thou hast redeemed by Thy great power, and by Thy strong hand.”

O Lord, hear the prayer of Thy servant, and let Thy name be revered; may the prayer of those who love Thee, even Thy servants, be accepted; and today grant mercy unto Thy servant, that in the sight of this man, mercy may be shown. And I was the cupbearer to the king.

In the reign of the king, in the twentieth year of the kingdom, in the month of Nisan, there was wine before him; and I took the wine and gave it to the king. Now there was no other man present before him.
And the king said unto me, "Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart." Then I was very sore afraid.

And I said unto the king, "Let the king live forever; why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchers, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?"
And the king said unto me, "For what dost thou make request?" So I prayed to the God of heaven.

And I said unto the king, "If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favor in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchers, that I may build it."
And the queen also sitting by him said, "For how long shall thy journey be? And when wilt thou return?" So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
Moreover, I said unto the king, "If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah."

And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into." And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
And when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ደረስሁ፤ በዚያም ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጥሁ።
በሌሊትም ተነሣሁ፤ ከእኔም ጋር ጥቂት ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለኢየሩሳሌም አደርገው ዘንድ በልቤ ያኖረውን ለማንም አላስታወቅሁም፤ ተቀምጬበት ከነበረው እንስሳ በቀር ከእኔ ጋር ምንም እንስሳ አልነበረም።
በሸለቆውም በር ወጣሁ፤ ወደ በለስም ምንጭና ወደ ጕድፍ መጣያው በር ሄድሁ፤ የፈረሰውንም የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር፥ በእሳትም የተቃጠሉትን በሮችዋን ተመለከትሁ።
ወደ ምንጩም በርና ወደ ንጉሡም መዋኛ አለፍሁ፤ ተቀምጬበት የነበረው እንስሳም የሚያልፍበት ስፍራ አልነበረም።
በሌሊትም በፈፋው በኩል ወጥቼ ቅጥሩን ተመለከትሁ፤ በሸለቆውም በር ገባሁ፤ እንዲሁም ተመለስሁ።
ጠባቆች ግን ወዴት እንደ ሄድሁ፥ ምን እንዳደረግሁም አላወቁም ነበር፤ ለአይሁድና ለካህናቱ፥ ለታላላቆችና ለሹሞቹም፥ ሥራም ይሠሩ ለነበሩት ለሌሎች እስከዚያ ጊዜ ገና አልተናገርሁም ነበር።
እኔም፥ “እኛ ያለንበትን ጕስቍልና፥ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ፈረሰች፥ በሮችዋም በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠሉ ታያላችሁ። አሁንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ መሳለቂያ እንዳንሆን ኑና የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር እንሥራ” አልኋቸው።
የአምላኬም እጅ በእኔ ላይ መልካም እንደ ሆነች፥ ንጉሡም የነገረኝን ቃል ነገርኋቸው። “ተነሡ እንሥራ” አልኋቸው። እጆቻቸውንም ለበጎ ሥራ አበረቱ።
ሖሮናዊውም ሰንባላጥ፥ አገልጋዩም አሞናዊው ጦቢያ፥ ዓረባዊውም ጌሳም በሰሙ ጊዜ በንቀት ሳቁብን፤ ቀላል አድርገውንም ወደ እኛ መጡና፥ “ይህ የምታደርጉት ነገር ምንድን ነው? በውኑ በንጉሡ ላይ ትሸፍቱ ዘንድ ትወድዳላችሁን?” አሉ።
እኔም መልሼ፥ “የሰማይ አምላክ ያከናውንልናል፤ እኛም ንጹሓን ባሪያዎቹ ተነሥተን እንሠራለን፤ እናንተ ግን በኢየሩሳሌም ዕድል ፋንታና መብት፥ መታሰቢያም የላችሁም” አልኋቸው።
ታላቁም ካህን ኤልያሴብና ወንድሞቹ ካህናት ተነሥተው የበግ በር ሠሩ፤ ቀደሱትም፤ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፤ እስከ መቶ ግንብና እስከ ሐናንኤል ግንብ ድረስ ቀደሱት።
በአጠገቡም የኢያሪኮ ሰዎች ሠሩ፤ በአጠገባቸውም የአምሪ ልጅ የዘኩር ልጆች ሠሩ።
የአስናሃ ልጆችም የዓሣ በር ሠሩ፤ ሠረገሎቹንም አኖሩ፤ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ።
በአጠገባቸውም የቆስ ልጅ የኡርያ ልጅ ሚራሞት ይሠራ ጀመረ። በአጠገባቸውም የሜሴዜቤል ልጅ የበራክያ ልጅ ሜሱላም ይሠራ ጀመረ። በአጠገባቸውም የበሃና ልጅ ሳዶቅ ይሠራ ጀመረ።
በአጠገባቸውም ቴቁሓውያን ይሠሩ ጀመሩ፤ ታላላቆቻቸው ግን ለሥራው አንገታቸውን አላዋረዱም።
የፋሴሓ ልጅ ኢዮዳሄና የበሶድያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አሮጌውን በር አደሱ፤ ሰረገሎቹን አኖሩ፤ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፤ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ።
በአጠገባቸውም ገባዖናዊው መልጥያና ሜሮናታዊው ያዴን፥ እስከ ወንዙም ማዶ አለቃ ግዛት የሆኑ የገባዖንና የመሴፋ ሰዎች ሠሩ።
በአጠገባቸውም ወርቅ አንጥረኛው የሐሬህያ ልጅ ዑዝኤል ሠራ። በአጠገቡም ከሽቱ ቀማሚዎች የነበረ ሐናንያ ሠራ፤ እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ ኢየሩሳሌምን ጠገኑ።
በአጠገባቸውም የኢየሩሳሌም ግዛት እኩሌታ አለቃ የሆር ልጅ ረፋያ ሠራ።
በአጠገባቸውም የኤርማፍ ልጅ ይዳያ በቤቱ አንጻር ያለውን ሠራ። በአጠገቡም የአሰብንብሔም ልጅ ሐጡስ ሠራ።
The son of Kariim, Melkiah, and the son of Pahath-moab, Hashub, repaired another section and the door of its entrance.
And beside them, the rulers of the district of Jerusalem, including Shallum the son of Col-hozeh, and the daughters of his house, repaired.

Hanun and the inhabitants of the Zanoah repaired the gate of the fountain; they built it and set up its doors, with its bolts and bars; and they also built a wall unto the pool of Shelah, by the king's garden, unto the stairs that go down from the city of David, a thousand cubits in length.

The ruler of the district of Beth-haccerem, Melkiah the son of Rechab, repaired the gate of the entrance to the wall, with his brethren and his sons; they built it and set up its doors, with its bolts and bars.

And the ruler of the district of Meshefa, Shallum the son of Col-hozeh, repaired the gate of the fountain; he built it and set up its doors, with its bolts and bars; and he built the wall unto the place of the king's garden, even unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

After him, the ruler of the district of Beth-zur, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, repaired the wall over against the sepulchres of David, even unto the place that was made for the dwelling, even unto the house of the mighty men.
After him, the Levites and the son of Bani, Rehum, repaired; and beside them, the ruler of the district of Keilah, and the ruler of the villages, Asabiah, repaired.
After him, the ruler of the district of Keilah, Beniah the son of En-hadad, and his brethren repaired.
Beside them, the ruler of the district of Meshefa, Azur the son of Jehoiada, repaired the other section over against the house of the guard.
After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai, from the place of the guard unto the great priest Eliashib's house, repaired the other section.
And after him, the son of Achos, the son of Uriah, Miramoth, began at the entrance of the house of Eliashib and worked until the end of the house of Eliashib, and he made another section.
And after him, the men of the surrounding area worked as priests.
And after them, Benjamin and Asseb worked beside their house. And after them, Hananiah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Meaziah, worked beside his house.
And after him, the son of Inhadad, Bani, began at the house of Azariah and worked until the wall of the broad place and the gate of the guard.

The son of Uzziah, Phalal, worked beside the wall of the broad place and beside the gate of the king’s house above, and he built the gate that stood there. And after him, the son of Pharos, Pedaiah, worked.
And Nethanim dwelt in Ophel, beside the water gate, toward the east, and they built beside the gate that stood there until the place was completed.
And after him, the Tequahites worked beside the great gate until the gate of Ophel.
Above the horse gate, the priests worked, each one beside his own house.
And thereafter, the son of Hammer, Sadok, worked beside his house. And after him, the keeper of the east gate, the son of Shecaniah, worked.

And after him, the son of Shelemiah, Hananiah, and the sixth son of Zeluph, Hanun, worked another section. And thereafter, the son of Berechiah, Meshullam, worked beside the chamber of the gatekeepers.
And after him, the son of the cherub, Melchiah, worked until the house of Nathan-melech, and unto the gate that leadeth out to the broad way, even unto the place of the water gate, he did work.
And from the place of the water gate they began, even unto the gate of the sheep, goldsmiths and merchants did work.

sections.title: Nehemiah established the adversaries as they were arranged.

verses.text: ሰንባላጥም ቅጥሩን እንደ ሠራን በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣ፤ ተበሳጨም፤ በአይሁድም ሳቀባቸው።
በወንድሞቹና በሰማርያ ሠራዊትም ፊት፥ “ከተማቸውን የሚሠሩ እነዚህ ደካሞች አይሁድ ኀይላቸው ምንድን ነው? ይተዉላቸዋልን? ይሠዋሉን? በአንድ ቀንስ ይጨርሳሉን? የተቃጠለውንስ ድንጋይ ከፍርስራሹ መልሰው ያድኑታልን?” ብሎ ተናገረ።
አሞናዊውም ጦቢያ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ፥ “በድንጋይ በሚሠሩት ቅጥራቸው ላይ ቀበሮ ቢወጣበት ያፈርሰዋል” አለ።
አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ተንቀናልና ስማ፤ ስድባቸውን በራሳቸው ላይ መልስባቸው፤ በምርኮ ሀገር ለብዝበዛ አሳልፈህ ስጣቸው።
በደላቸውንም አትክደን፤ ኀጢአታቸውም ከፊትህ አይደምሰስ፤ በሠራተኞች ፊት አስቈጥተውሃልና።
ቅጥሩንም ሠራን፤ ቅጥሩም ሁሉ እስከ እኩሌታው ድረስ ተጋጠመ፤ ሕዝቡ ከልብ ይሠራ ነበርና።
ሰንባላጥና ጦብያም፥ ዓረባውያንም፥ አሞናውያንም፥ አዛጦናውያንም የኢየሩሳሌም ቅጥር እየታደሰ እንደ ሄደ፥ የፈረሰውም ሊጠገን እንደ ተጀመረ በሰሙ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጡ።
መጥተውም ኢየሩሳሌምን ይወጉና ያፈርሷት ዘንድ ሁሉም በአንድነት ተሰበሰቡ።
እኛም ወደ አምላካችን ጸለይን፤ ከእነርሱም የተነሣ በአንጻራቸው ተጠባባቂዎችን በሌሊትና በቀን አደረግን።
ይሁዳም፥ “የተሸካሚዎች ኀይል ደከመ፤ ፍርስራሹም ብዙ ነው፤ ቅጥሩንም እንሠራ ዘንድ አንችልም” አሉ።
Our adversaries say, “Until we come among them and until we prevail over them, they will not know their work; they will not see.”
And those who were stationed beside them came and said, “Let them come from all around, for it is ten times that they have spoken to us.”
From behind the gate, in the lower part that is on the side of the place of the watch, they drew their swords and their weapons, and they stood the people in their respective ranks;

I cannot rise; to the mighty and the strong, and to those who remain of the people, I said, “Do not be afraid of them; remember the great and terrible God, and fight for your brethren, for your sons and your daughters, for your wives and your houses.”
Our enemies, as they are aware, have heard that the Lord has made their counsel of no effect; and we all returned to the gate, each one to his work.
From that day forward, the whole of the brethren worked; and the brethren, with their weapons and armor, kept watch before and behind; and the leaders stood behind all the house of Judah.
Those who worked on the gate and the bearers of burdens worked with one hand; and with the other hand, they held their weapons.
And the porters, each one, worked with his sword at his side; and the sound of the trumpet was beside them.
To the mighty and the strong, and to those who remain of the people, I said, “The work is great and extensive; and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another;
The sound of the trumpet, when you hear it, gather unto us there; our God will fight for us,” I said to them.
And the work was to be done; from the dawn until the stars began to appear, the soldiers would hold their positions.
Moreover, at that time, he said to the people, "All of you dwell within Jerusalem with your families; let your watchmen be vigilant by night, and by day let them labor."
I and my brethren, along with the watchmen who were behind us, did not remove our garments; and when we went to draw water, we carried our weapons with us.
በወንድሞቻቸውም በአይሁድ ላይ ትልቅ የሕዝቡና የሚስቶቻቸው ጩኸት ሆነ።
“ከወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችን ጋር ብዙዎች ነን፤ በልተንም በሕይወት እንድንኖር እህልን እንሸምት” የሚሉ ነበሩ።
“ከራብ የተነሣም እህልን እንሸምት ዘንድ እርሻችንንና ወይናችንን፥ ቤታችንንም አስይዘናል” የሚሉ ነበሩ።
ሌሎቹም “ለንጉሡ ግብር እርሻችንንና ወይናችንን አስይዘን ገንዘብ ተበድረናል፤
አሁንም ሥጋችን እንደ ወንድሞቻችን ሥጋ፥ ልጆቻችንም እንደ ልጆቻቸው ናቸው፤ እነሆም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችን ባሪያዎች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሰጥተናል፤ ከሴቶችም ልጆቻችን ባሪያዎች ሆነው የሚኖሩ አሉ፤ ታላላቆችም እርሻችንንና ወይናችንን ይዘዋልና ልናድናቸው አንችልም” የሚሉ ነበሩ።
እኔም ጩኸታቸውንና ይህን ቃል በሰማሁ ጊዜ እጅግ ዐዘንሁ።
በልቤም አሰብሁ፤ ታላላቆቹንና ሹሞቹንም፥ “ሁላችሁ እያንዳንዳችሁ ወለድ ትወስዳላችሁ” ብዬ ተጣላኋቸው፤ ትልቅም ጉባኤ ሰበሰብሁባቸው።
እኔም፥ “ለአሕዛብ የተሸጡትን ወንድሞቻችንን አይሁድን በፈቃዳችን ተቤዠን፤ እናንተስ ወንድሞቻችሁን ትሸጣላችሁን? እነርሱስ ለእኛ የተሸጡ ይሆናሉን?” አልኋቸው። እነርሱም ዝም አሉ፤ መልስም አላገኙም።
ደግሞም አልሁ፥ “የምታደርጉት ነገር መልካም አይደለም፤ ጠላቶቻችን አሕዛብ እንዳይሰድቡን አምላካችንን በመፍራት ትሄዱ ዘንድ አይገባችሁምን?
እኔ ደግሞ፥ ወንድሞችም፥ ብላቴኖችም ገንዘብና እህል ለእነርሱ አበድረናል፤ እባካችሁ፥ ይህን ወለድ እንተውላቸው።
እርሻቸውን፥ የወይናቸውንና የወይራቸውን ቦታ፥ ቤታቸውንም፥ ከእነርሱም የወሰዳችሁትን ገንዘቡንና እህሉን፥ ወይን ጠጁንና ዘይቱን እባካችሁ ዛሬ መልሱላቸው።”
እነርሱም፥ “እንመልስላቸዋለን፤ ከእነርሱም ምንም አንሻም፤ እንደተናገርህ እንዲሁ እናደርጋለን” አሉ። ካህናቱንም ጠርቼ እንደዚህ ነገር ያደርጉ ዘንድ አማልኋቸው።
ደግሞም ልብሴን አራገፍሁና፥ “ይህን ነገር የማያደርገውን ሰው ከቤቱና ከሥራው እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ያራግፈው፤ እንዲሁ የተራገፈና ባዶ ይሁን” አልሁ። ጉባኤውም ሁሉ፥ “አሜን” አሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አመሰገኑ፤ ሕዝቡም እንደዚህ ነገር አደረጉ።
ንጉሡም በይሁዳ ምድር ላይ አለቃ እሆን ዘንድ ካዘዘኝ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ከንጉሡ ከአርተሰስታ ከሃያኛው ዓመት እስከ ሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ድረስ ዐሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ያህል እኔና ወንድሞች ለአለቃ የሚገባውን ቀለብ አልበላንም።
ከእኔ አስቀድመው የነበሩት አለቆች ግን በሕዝቡ ላይ አክብደው ነበር፤ ስለ እንጀራውና ስለ ወይኑ አርባ ሰቅል ብር ይወስዱ ነበር፤ ሎሌዎቻቸውም ደግሞ በሕዝቡ ላይ ይሰለጥኑ ነበር። እኔ ግን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ፈራሁ እንዲህ አላደረግሁም።
ደግሞም የቅጥሩን ሥራ ሠራሁ፤ እርሻም አልገዛሁም፤ ብላቴኖችም ሁሉ ወደዚያው ወደ ሥራው ተሰበሰቡ።
ደግሞም በዙሪያችን ካሉት አሕዛብ ወደ እኛ ከመጡት ሌላ ከአይሁድና ከሹሞቹ መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች በገበታዬ ነበሩ።
ለአንድ ቀን አንድ በሬና ስድስት የሰቡ በጎች፥ አንድ ፍየልም፥ በዐሥር በዐሥር ቀንም ብዙ ልዩ ልዩ ዓይነት ወይን ጠጅ ይዘጋጅልኝ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን አገዛዝ በሕዝቡ ላይ ከብዶ ነበርና ለአለቃ የሚገባውን ቀለብ አልሻም ነበር።
አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ ለበጎነት አስብልኝ።

And thus it came to pass; as I had made the gate, I was not afraid of anything that might come upon me, for I had heard the words of our enemies; yet until that time, I had not ceased from my watch within the gates.
And the messenger said, "Come, let us meet in the villages that are within the walls of Ono"; but they were plotting to do me harm.
And I sent messengers unto them, saying, "I am doing a great work, and I cannot come down; why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?"
And thus I sent unto them four times; and I answered them in like manner.
And the messenger sent to me in the fifth time, with an open letter in his hand, saying:

"You and the Jews have conspired against me, for this reason you are building the wall, that you may become their king, and you have also set up prophets to proclaim concerning you at Jerusalem, saying, 'There is a king in Judah.'"
Moreover, they said, "There is a king in Judah," and now it will be reported to the king concerning you; so come now, let us take counsel together."
And I said unto him, "You are not speaking from your heart, but as you have spoken, it is not so."
And they all said that the work should not be done, saying, "Their hands will become weak"; therefore I strengthened my hands.

And I went in unto Shemaiah the son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, and he was shut up; and he said unto me, "Let us go into the house of the Lord, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you by night."
And I said, "Who is he that is like me, who has fled, and who can save his soul, that he may enter the sanctuary? I also have not entered."
And the Lord, as if He had not sent me, yet upon me the prophecy was spoken, behold, I know; Tobiah and Sanballat were greatly distressed against me.
Therefore, I shall do this matter and I shall be bold, that upon me they may speak of evil and they may conspire against me, I was greatly troubled.
O my God, for this work, Tobiah and Sanballat, and also the prophetess Noadiah, cause me to be afraid, for they desired what they sought, consider also the remaining prophets.

sections.title: The work of the wall's construction.

verses.text: The wall was completed on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.

And it came to pass that when our enemies heard of this, all the nations that were around us were afraid; they were greatly cast down in their own eyes, for they perceived that this work was done by our God.
And in those days, many of the leaders of Judah sent letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah's letters came to them.
For Tobiah, being the son of Shecaniah, the son of Arah, and his son Johanan, the son of Berechiah, had taken the daughter of Meshullam, the son of Berechiah; and many in Judah were allied with him.
Moreover, they spoke well of him before me, and they brought his words to me, and I gave them my words; thus Tobiah sent letters to frighten me.
And it came to pass; after the wall was built, I set the gates, and the singers and the Levites were appointed.
And I commanded my brother Hanani and the ruler of the castle, Hananiah, concerning Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God more than many.

And I said, “The gates of Jerusalem shall not be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors and bar them; and appoint guards from among the inhabitants of Jerusalem, some at their watch, and some before their own houses.”
The city was large and great; but the people within it were few, and the houses were not built.

sections.title: A list of those who returned from exile, the Jews.

verses.text: And the Lord stirred my heart to call forth the great and the small, and the people, to gather them according to their generations; I found the book of their genealogy, and in it, I found this written.
These are the children of the land who returned from the captivity of Babylon, under the reign of King Nabuchadnezzar, to Jerusalem and to Judah, each to their own city.

They came from Zerubbabel, from Jeshua, from Nehemiah, from Azariah, from Rehumiah, from Hemenes, from Merodach, from Belsama, from Misferet, from Ezra, from Beguwai, from Nehum, from Beana, along with the others. This is the number of men from the people of Israel.
The children of Parosh were two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
The children of Shephatiah were three hundred seventy-two.
The children of Era were six hundred fifty-two.
The children of Jahaziah and the children of Joab, who were of the descendants of the Moabites, were two thousand eight hundred eighteen.
The children of Elam were one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
The children of Zattu were eight hundred forty-five.
The children of Zaccai were seven hundred sixty.
The children of Benui, six hundred forty-eight.
The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-eight.
The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty-two.
The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-seven.
The children of Bigvai, two thousand sixty-seven.
The children of Aden, six hundred fifty-five.
The children of Hezekiah, the descendants of Ater, ninety-eight.
The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty-eight.
The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-four.
The children of Hariph, one hundred twelve.
The children of Geba numbered five hundred.
The men of Bethlehem and the men of Netophah numbered eight hundred seventy.
The men of Anathoth numbered twenty-eight hundred.
The men of Beth Azmaveth numbered forty-two.
The men of Kiriath Jearim, and the men of Chephirah, and the men of Beeroth numbered seven hundred forty-three.
The men of Haramah and the men of Geba numbered six hundred twenty-one.
The men of Micmas numbered twenty-two.
The men of Bethel and Ai numbered twenty-three.
The men of Nebo numbered fifty-two.
The men of Elam numbered one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
የኤራም ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ሃያ።
የኢያሪኮ ልጆች ሦስት መቶ አርባ አምስት።
የሎድና ሐዲድ የሐኖም ልጆች ሰባት መቶ ሃያ አንድ።
የሴናዓ ልጆች ሦስት ሺህ ዘጠኝ መቶ ሠላሳ።
ካህናቱ ከኢያሱ ወገን፦ የዮዳሔ ልጆች ዘጠኝ መቶ ሰባ ሦስት።
የኤሜር ልጆች ሺህ አምሳ ሁለት።
የፋስኮር ልጆች ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አርባ ሰባት።
የሐራም ልጆች ሺህ ዐሥራ ሰባት።
ሌዋውያኑም ከሆዳይዋ ወገን የኢያሱና የቀድምኤል ልጆች ሰባ አራት።
መዘምራኑ የአሳፍ ልጆች መቶ አርባ ስምንት።
The children of Berengoch, the children of Shelemiah, the children of Ater, the children of Telmana, the children of Aqob, the children of Hattita, the children of Sobai, four hundred and eighty.
The children of Natanim, the children of Sia, the children of Hasupha;
The children of Keras, the children of Asiah, the children of Phadon;
The children of Libana, the children of Agaba, the children of Selmai;
The children of Hanan, the children of Gedel, the children of Gaar;
The children of Reaiah, the children of Reason, the children of Nekoda;
The children of Gasham, the children of Uzi, the children of Phaseah;

The children of Beqbuk, the children of Hachupha, the children of Harur;
The children of Besloth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha;
የበርቆስ ልጆች፥ የሲሣራ ልጆች፥ የታማህ ልጆች፥
የነስያ ልጆች፥ የሐጤፋ ልጆች።
የሰሎሞን አገልጋዮች ልጆች፤ የሦጠይ ልጆች፥ የሰፋሬት ልጆች፥ የፈሪዳ ልጆች፥
የየዕላ ልጆች፥ የደርቆን ልጆች፥ የጌዴል ልጆች፤
የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች፥ የሐጢል ልጆች፥ የፈከራት ልጆች፥ የሰባይም ልጆች፥ የአሞን ልጆች።
ናታኒም ሁሉና የሰሎሞን አገልጋዮች ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ዘጠና ሁለት ነበሩ።
ከቲልሜል፥ ከቲላሬስ፥ ከኪሩብ፥ ከአዶን፥ ከኢሜር የወጡ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ነገር ግን የአባቶቻቸውን ቤቶችና ዘራቸውን ወይም ከእስራኤል ወገን መሆናቸውን ያስታውቁ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤
የዳላያ ልጆች፥ የጦብያ ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች ስድስት መቶ አርባ ሁለት።
ከካህናቱም የአብያ ልጆች፥ የአቆስ ልጆች፥ ከገለዓዳዊው ከቤርዜሊ ልጆች ሚስት ያገባ፥ በስሙም የተጠራ የቤርዜሊ ልጆች።
እነዚህ በትውልድ መጽሐፍ ትውልዳቸውን ፈለጉ፤ ነገር ግን አልተገኘም፤ ከክህነትም ተከለከሉ።
And he said, "You shall not eat of anything that is holy until the priest has arisen to judge, for it is a matter that has been consecrated."
And the assembly was composed of forty-two thousand three hundred sixty.
Behold, there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven men, besides their servants and maidservants, two hundred forty-five men who sang, and women who sang were among them.
Their horses numbered seven hundred thirty-six, and their mules were two hundred forty-five.
Their camels were four hundred thirty-five, and their donkeys were six thousand seven hundred twenty.
And the leaders of the fathers' houses gave to the work a gift. And he gave one thousand gold drachmas, fifty bowls, and five hundred thirty priestly garments for the house of the treasury.
And the leaders of the fathers' houses gave twenty thousand gold drachmas, two thousand two hundred silver coins for the work of the house of the treasury.
And the rest of the people gave twenty thousand gold drachmas and two thousand silver coins, and sixty-seven priestly garments were among them.
And the priests and the Levites, the singers and the gatekeepers, and the people of Israel all dwelt in their cities.

sections.title: Ezra had the law of the Lord as it was written.

verses.text: And it came to pass in the seventh month, that the children of Israel were in their cities. And all the people gathered themselves together as one man unto the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded to Israel.
And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Aniah, and Uriah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; for he was above all the people; and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the Lord with their faces to the ground.

Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, and Jamin, and Akkub, and Shabbethai, and Hodiah, and Maaseiah, and Kelita, and Azariah, and Jehozabad, and Hanan, and Peliah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
And they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people said unto all the people, “This day is holy unto the Lord your God; mourn not, nor weep.” For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

Then he said unto them, “Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.”
And the Levites said, "The day is holy; be silent; do not grieve." Thus the people were made to be still.
And all the people understood the words that were spoken to them, and they went to eat and to drink, and to send portions, and to rejoice greatly.
And on the second day, the heads of the fathers' houses, along with the priests and the Levites, gathered to Ezra the scribe to seek the words of the Law.

And in the seventh month, on the feast of the children of Israel, they dwelt in booths in their cities and in Jerusalem, and they spoke and proclaimed that the Lord had commanded through Moses, and they found it written in the Law.
And Ezra said to them, "Go to the mountain and bring olive branches and branches of wild trees, and myrtle branches and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written."

And the people went out and brought them, and each one made a booth for himself, in his own house, and in the place of the Lord's house, and by the water gate, and by the gate of Ephraim, they made booths.

And all the assembly of those who had returned from the captivity made booths and dwelt in the booths. Since the days of Joshua the son of Nun until that day, the children of Israel had not done so. And there was very great gladness.

From the first day of the month until the last day of the feast, they read in the Book of the Law of God day by day. And they kept the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day, as was their custom, they held a solemn assembly.

sections.title: The people shall confess their transgressions.

verses.text: In this month, on the twenty-fourth day, the children of Israel fasted, gathered together, and confessed their sins before the Lord, and they stood in their place.
And the children of Israel separated themselves from all foreign peoples, and they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
And in their places, they stood and read from the book of the law of the Lord their God; and they confessed to the Lord their God, and they worshiped the Lord their God.
And the Levites, Jeshua and the children of Kadmiel, the children of the singers, and the children of the Kenites stood upon their stations and cried out with a loud voice to their God, to the Lord.

And the Levites, Jeshua and Kadmiel, said, "Stand up and bless the Lord your God from everlasting to everlasting; and let them bless Your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise."

Ezra said, "You alone are God, O Lord; You have created the heavens and the heaven of heavens, all their host, the earth and all that is in it, the seas and all that is in them; You give life to all, and the host of heaven worships You."
You, O Lord, are God; You chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans, and gave him the name Abraham.

His heart was found faithful before You; You made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, and the Girgashites to him and to his descendants. You have kept Your word, for You are righteous.
"In Egypt, You saw the affliction of our fathers; in the Red Sea, You heard their cry.

As You had made known to them, You showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh and all his servants, and against all the people of his land; for You knew that they acted arrogantly against them. Today, as it was then, You called upon Your name.
You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on dry ground; and their pursuers You hurled into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.
You led them by day with a pillar of cloud, and by night with a pillar of fire, to light for them the way in which they should go.
You came down upon Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven; You gave them just ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments.
You made known to them Your holy Sabbath, and commanded them precepts, statutes, and laws by the hand of Your servant Moses.

You gave them bread from heaven for their hunger, and brought forth water for them from the rock for their thirst; and You commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which You had sworn to give them.
"Yet they and our fathers have rebelled; they have turned aside their backs; they have not heeded Your commandment,

They have said, 'We will not listen'; they have not remembered the wonders that You performed among them; they have turned aside their backs; they have returned to Egypt for their bondage, saying, 'You, however, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love; You do not forsake them.'
And the chief of the people spoke, saying, 'The gods that brought us up from Egypt are these'; they have greatly provoked You.

Yet You, in Your mercy, did not forsake them in the wilderness; the pillar of cloud did not depart from them by day, to lead them on the way, nor the pillar of fire by night, to give them light on the path in which they should go.
You also gave Your good Spirit to instruct them; You did not withhold Your manna from their mouth, and You gave them water for their thirst.
For forty years You sustained them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing; their clothes did not wear out, and their feet did not swell.
"You gave them kingdoms and nations, and divided them into districts; they took possession of the land of Sihon, the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og, the king of Bashan.
You multiplied their children as the stars of heaven; and You brought them into the land which You had told their fathers to go in and possess.

And they took possession of the land; and You destroyed before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, to do with them as they wished.

And they captured fortified cities and a rich land, and took possession of houses full of all good things, cisterns already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance; so they ate and were filled and grew fat, and delighted themselves in Your great goodness."
"Yet they turned back and provoked Your anger; they cast aside Your law; and they killed Your prophets who warned them to return to You; they greatly offended You."

"Therefore, You delivered them into the hands of those who afflicted them; and in the time of their trouble, they cried out to You; and from heaven, You heard them; and according to Your mercy, You gave them deliverers; and You saved them from the hands of those who afflicted them."

"But when they returned and did evil before You, they were delivered into the hands of their enemies; and when they cried out to You, You heard them from heaven; and according to Your mercy, You helped them."

"And they returned to Your law, yet You did not listen to them; and when a man acted wickedly, they forsook Your commandment and judgment; they turned their backs to You; they hardened their necks; they did not listen."
"Yet for many years You bore with them; and by Your prophets, You warned them in Your Spirit; yet they would not give heed; therefore, You delivered them into the hands of the peoples of the lands."
"But You are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and of great kindness; and You did not forsake them."

"Now, O our God, great and mighty, awesome and terrible, who keeps covenant and mercy, do not let all the trouble that has come upon us since the days of the kings of Assyria until this day be little before You."
"In all that has come upon us, You are just; for You have dealt faithfully, but we have done wickedly."
"Our kings, our leaders, our priests, and our fathers have not kept Your law, nor heeded Your commandments and Your testimonies, which You testified against them."
"In Your great goodness, You gave them kingdoms and nations, and they took possession of the land; but they did not turn from their wicked works."
Behold, today we are servants; we shall eat of its fruit and its blessing, which Thou hast given to our fathers in the land. Behold, we are servants in it.

Because of our transgressions, Thy sovereigns have been multiplied; she hath increased her blessing upon us; they shall possess our bodies; and they shall do unto our beasts that which they desire; and we are in great affliction.
Therefore, for all these things, we shall make a covenant with the faithful; our leaders, and our elders, and our priests shall be bound by it.

sections.title: The people entered into a covenant.

verses.text: የቀሩትም ሕዝብ፥ ካህናቱም፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በረኞቹም፥ መዘምራንም፥ ናታኒምም፥ ከምድርም አሕዛብ ራሳቸውን የለዩና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሕግ የገቡ ሁሉ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም፥ የሚያውቁትና የሚያስተውሉትም ሁሉ ወንድሞቻቸውንና ታላላቆቻቸውን አበረታቱ፤
በእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ በሙሴ እጅ በተሰጠው በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ፥ ፍርዱንም፥ ሥርዐቱንም ይጠብቁና ያደርጉ ዘንድ ርግማንንና መሐላን አደረጉ።
ሴቶች ልጆቻችንንም ለምድር አሕዛብ አንሰጥም፤ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ለልጆቻችን አንወስድም፤
የምድርንም አሕዛብ ሸቀጥና ልዩ ልዩ እህል ሊገበዩ በሰንበት ቀን ቢያመጡ በሰንበት ወይም በተቀደሰው ቀን ከእነርሱ አንገዛም፤ ሰባተኛውንም ዓመት እናከብራለን፤ ከሰውም ዕዳ ማስከፈልን እንተዋለን።
ስለ አምላካችንም ቤት ሥራ ሁሉ በየዓመቱ የሰቅል ሢሶ እናመጣ ዘንድ ሥርዐት በራሳችን ላይ እናደርጋለን።
ስለ አምላካችንም ቤት አገልግሎት፥ ስለ ኅብስተ ገጽም፥ ዘወትርም በሰንበትና በመባቻ ስለ ማቅረብ ስለ እህሉ ቍርባንና ስለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት፥ ስለ በዓላትም፥ ስለ ተቀደሱትም ነገሮች፥ ለእስራኤልም ስለሚያስተሰርየው ስለ ኀጢአት መሥዋዕት፥
እኛም ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ሕዝቡም፥ እንደ አባቶቻችን ቤቶች በተወሰነ ጊዜ በየዓመቱ ወደ አምላካችን ቤት አምጥተን በሕጉ እንደ ተጻፈ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ይቃጠል ዘንድ ስለ ዕንጨት ቍርባን ዕጣ ተጣጣልን፤
በየዓመቱም የመሬታችንን እህል ቀዳምያት፥ የሁሉ ዓይነት ዛፍ የፍሬ ቀዳምያት ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እናመጣ ዘንድ፥
በሕጉም እንደ ተጻፈ የልጆቻችንንና የእንስሶቻችንን በኵራት፥ የበሬዎቻችንንና የበጎቻችንን በኵራት በአምላካችን ቤት ወደሚያገለግሉት ካህናት ወደ አምላካችን ቤት እናመጣ ዘንድ፥
የእህላችንንም ቀዳምያት፥ የዛፉን ሁሉ ፍሬ፥ የወይኑንና የዘይቱንም ፍሬ ወደ ካህናቱ ወደ አምላካችን ቤት ጓዳዎች እናመጣ ዘንድ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ከከተሞቻችን እርሻ ሁሉ ዐሥራት ይቀበላሉና የመሬታችንን ዐሥራት ወደ ሌዋውያን እናመጣ ዘንድ ማልን።
And the Levites shall be with the sons of Aaron the priest when the ten are received; and the Levites shall bring the ten to the house of our God, to the chambers, and to the storehouse.

The children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the first fruits of the grain and of the wine, and the first fruits of the oil, and the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests who minister, and the singers, and those who are appointed to their chambers; likewise, let them not neglect the house of our God.
And the leaders of the people dwelt in Jerusalem; and of the rest of the people, one part of ten remained in the holy city, and nine parts were in the other cities, and they were scattered.
And the people gathered together in Jerusalem, all those who were willing to dwell there.

And these are the leaders of the country who dwelt in Jerusalem; but Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of the servants of Solomon, each one according to their lineage and in their cities, dwelt in the cities of Judah.

And these dwelt in Jerusalem, of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: the son of Phares, the son of Malaleel, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Samaria, the son of Zechariah, the son of Uzziah.
The son of Shelah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Joarib, the son of Adiah, the son of Uzziah, the son of Kolhozeh, the son of Baruch, Measiah.
And all the children of Phares who dwelt in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty and eight valiant men.
And these are the children of Benjamin: the son of Jedaiah, the son of Atiah, the son of Measiah, the son of Shalum, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Jeshua, the son of Meshullam, the son of Shelah.
And after him, Gibeon and Selah, nine hundred twenty and eight were there.
And their chief was Joel, the son of Zichri; and Judah was second in the city.
And of the priests, Joadiah, the son of Joarib, and Jachin.
And the chief of the house of the Lord was Seriah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub.

And their brethren who performed the work of the house of the Lord were eight hundred twenty-two, the son of Melchiah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amaseiah, the son of Phelaliah, the son of Jerohoam, Adaiah.
And their brethren, the leaders of the houses of their fathers, were two hundred forty-two; the son of Immer, the son of Meshullam, the son of Ahazi, the son of Ezra, the son of Hamaniah.
And their brethren were two hundred eighty-eight mighty men; and their chief was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
Of the Levites, there was Bunni, the son of Asaph, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Samiah.
And of the Levites who were in the service outside the house of the Lord were the leaders, Shebhetiah and Jehozabad.

And at the time of prayer, the chief who began the thanksgiving was Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Mikah, and among his brethren was the second Bokiyah, the son of Idoth, the son of Gelal, the son of Samuah, Abdia.
In the holy city, all the Levites who were present were two hundred eighty-four.
And the gatekeepers who kept watch at the gates were Akkub and Talmon, and their brethren were one hundred seventy-two.
And those who remained of Israel, of the priests and of the Levites, each one in their cities, were in all the cities of Judah.
And Nathaniel was settled in Ophal; and the sons of Hanan were over Nathaniel.

And in the house of the Lord, among those who were engaged in service, there was a son of Asaph, of the children of Merari, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bani, named Ozi, who was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem.
And upon them was the command of the king; and the order of the singers was established for each day.
And from the sons of Judah, from the lineage of Zarah, there was a son of Basyazebel named Fataiah, who was near the king concerning all matters of the people.
Concerning their dwellings and their fields, the sons of Judah had dwellings in Kiriath Arba and in their villages, in Dibon and in their villages, in Jekabzeel and in their villages,
in Ijash, in Moladah, in Beth-Palet,
in Hazar-Shual, in Beersheba and in their villages,
in Ziklag, in Mekonah and in their villages,
in En-Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
in Zanoah, in Adullam, and in their dwellings, in Lekish and in their fields, in Azekah and in their villages they settled. Thus they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
The sons of Benjamin began from Geba, at Machmas, at Aijalon, at Bethel and its villages,
at Anathoth, at Nob, at Hananiah,
at Hazor, at Ramah, at Gittaim;
at Hadid, at Zeboim, at Neballat,
at Lod, at Ono, they dwelt in Geharashim.
And they were separated from the Levites and dwelt in Judah and Benjamin.

sections.title: The list of the names of the Levites and the priests.

verses.text: And these were the priests and Levites who came with Zerubbabel and Jeshua, namely: Seriah, Jeremiah, Ezra;
Amariah, Maluk, Hattush;
Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth;
Abijah, Jamin, Ahitub;
Shabbethai, and Jozabad, and Belgah;
Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah;
Salim, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah; these were the leaders of the priests and their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
And the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, with their brethren, who were appointed to the service of song.
And their brethren were in the watch over the gates and in their appointed courses every week.
And Jeshua begat Joakim, and Joakim begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Jehoiada;
And Johadam begat Jonathan; and Jonathan begat Jedaiah.
In the days of Jehoiakim, the heads of the houses of the fathers were the brethren of the priests; from Seriah, Meraioth, and from Jeremiah, Hananiah;
From Ezra, Meshullam; from Amariah, Johanan;
From Malchijah, Jonathan; from Shebaniah, Joseph;
From Harim, Adnah; from Meraioth, Helkiah;
From Ado, Zechariah; from Genethon, Meshullam;
From Abijah, Zikri; from Miniamin and from Moadiah, Peltiah;
From Bilgah, Samuel; from Semaiah, Jonathan;
From Joarib, Metaniah; from Jodaiah, Uzziah;
From Saliah, Kallai; from Amok, Eber;
The son of Hilkiah, Hashabiah, is of the lineage of Idai, the son of Nathan.

And among the Levites, in the days of Eliashib and Johanan, and in the time of Johanan and Jaddua, were the leaders of the houses of their fathers; and the priests were recorded in the time of the Persian king Darius.
The sons of Levi were leaders of the houses of their fathers until the time of Eliashib, the son of Johanan, as recorded in the book of history.

And among the Levites were the leaders, Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua, and the sons of Kadmiel, and their brethren, who were to honor and give thanks before the Lord, according to the command of David, each week before them.
Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Abdaiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were the keepers of the storerooms beside the gates, to guard the items of the houses.
These were in the days of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, in the time of Nehemiah, the governor, and of Ezra, the priest and scribe.

sections.title: The Feast of the Dedication of the Temple of Jerusalem

verses.text: When the gate of Jerusalem was opened, the Levites gathered from every place to bring forth the offerings with joy and praise, with songs and instruments, and with the sound of the trumpet, to Jerusalem.
And the children of the singers were gathered round about Jerusalem and from other towns.
From the villages of the Netophathites and from the house of Gilgal, and from the fields of Geba, the singers had built for themselves towns round about Jerusalem.
And the priests and the Levites purified themselves; and the people, and the gates, and the wall were purified.
And the leaders of Judah brought them to the gate; and the thankful ones were stationed in two great companies; and one company went to the right hand of the gate towards the dung gate.
And after them, Hoshea, the leaders of Judah, were in agreement;
Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah;
And the Levites bore the instruments, the sons of the priests, the sons of Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Jonathan, the son of Zechariah;

And their brethren, Shemaiah, Azarel, Malalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Anani, who bore the vessels of the Lord, the instruments of David's song, went with them; and Ezra the scribe went before them.
በምንጭም በር አቅንተው ሄዱ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ደረጃ፥ በቅጥሩም መውጫ፥ ከዳዊትም ቤት በላይ እስከ ውኃው በር ድረስ በምሥራቅ በኩል ሄዱ።
ሁለተኛውም የአመስጋኞቹ ክፍል ወደ ግራ ሄደ፤ እኔና የሕዝቡም እኩሌታ በስተኋላቸው ነበርን፤ በቅጥሩም ላይ፥ በእቶኑ ግንብ በላይ እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ፥
ከኤፍሬምም በር በላይ፥ በአሮጌው በርና በዓሣ በር፥ በአናንኤልም ግንብ፥ በሃሜአ ግንብ እስከ በጎች በር ድረስ ሄዱ፤ በዘበኞችም በር አጠገብ ቆሙ።
እንዲሁ ሁለቱ የአመስጋኞች ክፍሎች በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ቆሙ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር እኔና የአለቆች እኩሌታ ነበርን፤
ካህናቱም ኤልያቄም፥ መዕሤያ፥ ሚንያሚን፥ ሚካያ፥ ኤልዮዔናይ፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ሐናንያ መለከት ይዘው፥
መዕሤያ፥ ሰማዕያ፥ ኤልየዜር፥ ኦዚ፥ ዮሐናን፥ ሚልክያ፥ ኤላም፥ ኤዝር፥ መዘምራኑም በታላቅ ድምፅ ዘመሩ፤ አለቃቸውም ይዝረአያ ነበረ።
እግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ደስታ ደስ አሰኝቶአቸዋልና በዚያ ቀን ትልቅ መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ፤ ደስም አላቸው፤ ሴቶቹና ልጆቹም ደግሞ ደስ አላቸው፤ ደስታቸውም በኢየሩሳሌም ከሩቅ ተሰማ።
የይሁዳም ሕዝብ በአገልጋዮቹ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን ደስ ስላላቸው፥ የካህናቱንና የሌዋውያኑን ዕድል ፈንታ እንደ ሕጉ ከከተሞች እርሻዎች ያከማቹ ዘንድ ለቀዳምያት፥ ለዐሥራትም በየዕቃ ቤቶቹ ላይ በዚያ ቀን ሰዎችን ሾሙ።
እነርሱም መዘምራኑና በረኞቹም የአምላካቸውን ሥርዐት የመንጻታቸውን ሥርዐት እንደ ዳዊትና እንደ ልጁ እንደ ሰሎሞን ትእዛዝ ጠበቁ።
በዳዊትም ዘመን አሳፍ የመዘምራን አለቃ ነበር፤ እነርሱም እግዚአብሔርን በዜማ ያመሰግኑ ነበር።

And all Israel, in the time of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah, would give their portions to the singers and to the gatekeepers each day; and they would give the consecrated things to the Levites; and the Levites would give a portion of the consecrated things to the children of Aaron.

sections.title: And the children of Israel were separated from the Ahzab.

verses.text: በዚያም ቀን የሙሴን መጽሐፍ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ አነበቡ፤ አሞናውያንና ሞዓባውያንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ ለዘለዓለም እንዳይገቡ የሚል በዚያ አገኙ።
የእስራኤልን ልጆች በእንጀራና በውኃ አልተቀበሉአቸውምና፥ ይረግማቸውም ዘንድ በለዓምን ገዝተውባቸዋልና፤ ነገር ግን አምላካችን ርግማኑን ወደ በረከት መለሰው።
ሕጉንም በሰሙ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ጋር የተደባለቀውን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ለዩ።
ከዚህም አስቀድሞ በአምላካችን ቤት ጓዳዎች ላይ ተሾሞ የነበረው ካህኑ ኤልያሴብ ከጦብያ ጋር ተወዳጅቶ፥
ለሌዋውያን፥ ለመዘምራንና ለበረኞቹ እንደ ሕጉ የተሰጣቸውን የእህሉን ቍርባንና ዕጣኑን፥ ዕቃዎቹንም፥ የእህሉንና የወይኑን፥ የዘይቱንም ዐሥራት፥ ለካህናቱም የሆነውን ቀዳምያቱን አስቀድሞ ያስቀመጡበትን ታላቅ ዕቃ ቤት አዘጋጅቶለት ነበር።
እኔ ግን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በአርተሰስታ በሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ወደ ንጉሡ ሄጄ ነበርና በዚህ ጊዜ በኢየሩሳሌም አልነበርሁም። ከጥቂት ዘመንም በኋላ የንጉሡን ፈቃድ ለመንሁ፤
ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣሁ፤ ኤልያሴብም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ለጦቢያ ዕቃ ቤቱን በማዘጋጀት ያደረገውን ክፉ ነገር አስተዋልሁ።
እጅግም አስከፋኝ፤ የጦብያንም የቤቱን ዕቃ ሁሉ ከዕቃ ቤት ወደ ውጭ ጣልሁ።
ዕቃ ቤቶቹንም እንዲያነጹ አዘዝሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ዕቃዎች፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን፥ ዕጣኑንም መልሼ በዚያ አገባሁ።
ለሌዋውያንም ፈንታቸው እንዳልተሰጠ፥ የሚያገለግሉትም ሌዋውያንና መዘምራን እያንዳንዱ ወደ እርሻው እንደ ሄደ ተመለከትሁ።
እኔም፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስለ ምን ተተወ?” ብዬ ከአለቆቹ ጋር ተከራከርሁ። ሰበሰብኋቸውም፤ በየስፍራቸውም አቆምኋቸው።
ይሁዳም ሁሉ የእህሉንና የወይኑን የዘይቱንም ዐሥራት ወደ ዕቃ ቤቶች አመጡ።
በዕቃ ቤቶችም ላይ ካህኑን ሰሌምያን፥ ጸሓፊውንም ሳዶቅን፥ ከሌዋውያኑም ፈዳያን ሾምሁ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር የመታንያ ልጅ የዘኩር ልጅ ሐናን ነበረ፤ እነርሱም የታመኑ ሆነው ተገኙ፤ ሥራቸውም ለወንድሞቻቸው ማከፋፈል ነበረ።
አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ አስበኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ያደረግሁትን ወረታዬን አታጥፋ።
በዚያም ወራት በይሁዳ በሰንበት ቀን የወይን መጭመቂያን የሚረግጡትን፥ ነዶም የሚከምሩትን፥ የወይኑን ጠጅና የወይኑን ዘለላ፤ በለሱንም፥ ልዩ ልዩም ዓይነት ሸክም በአህዮች ላይ የሚጭኑትን፥ በሰንበትም ቀን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም የሚያስገቡትን አየሁ፤ ገበያም ባደረጉበት ቀን አስመሰከርሁባቸው።
ደግሞም በእርስዋ የተቀመጡ ነበሩ፤ እነርሱም ዓሣዎችን፥ ልዩ ልዩም ዓይነት ሸቀጥ አምጥተው በሰንበት ቀን በኢየሩሳሌም ለይሁዳ ልጆች ይሸጡ ነበር።
ከይሁዳም አለቆችና ታላላቆች ጋር ተከራከርሁና እንዲህ አልኋቸው፥ “ይህ የምታደርጉት ክፉ ነገር ምንድን ነው? የሰንበትንስ ቀን ታረክሳላችሁን?
አባቶቻችሁ እንደዚህ አድርገው አልነበረምን? አምላካችንስ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በእኛና በዚች ከተማ ላይ አምጥቶ አልነበረምን? እናንተስ ሰንበትን በማርከሳችሁ በእስራኤል ላይ መዓትን ትጨምራላችሁ?”
ከዚህ በኋላ ሰንበት ከመግባቱ በፊት በኢየሩሳሌም በሮች ድንግዝግዝታ በሆነ ጊዜ በሮችዋ እንዲዘጉ፥ ሰንበትም እስኪያልፍ ድረስ እንዳይከፈቱ አዘዝሁ። በሰንበትም ቀን ሸክም እንዳይገባ ከብላቴኖች በዐያሌዎቹ በሮችዋን አስጠበቅሁ።
ሁሉም አንድ ወይም ሁለት ጊዜ ከኢየሩሳሌም ውጭ አድረው ገበያ አድርገው ነበር።
እኔም አስመሰከርሁባቸውና፥ “ከቅጥሩ ውጭ ለምን ታድራላችሁ? እንደ ገና ብታደርጉት እጆችን አነሣባችኋለሁ” አልኋቸው። ከዚያም ጊዜ ጀምሮ በሰንበት ቀን እንደ ገና አልመጡም።
ሌዋውያኑንም ራሳቸውን እንዲያነጹ፥ መጥተውም በሮቹን እንዲጠብቁ፥ የሰንበትንም ቀን እንዲቀድሱ ነገርኋቸው። “አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ደግሞ አስበኝ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህም ብዛት ራራልኝ” አልሁ።
ደግሞም በዚያ ወራት የአዛጦንንና የአሞንን፥ የሞዓብንም ሴቶች ያገቡትን አይሁድ አየሁ።
ከልጆቻቸውም እኩሌቶቹ በአዛጦን ቋንቋ ይናገሩ ነበር፤ በሌሎች ሕዝብ ቋንቋ የሚናገሩም ነበሩ፤ በአይሁድም ቋንቋ መናገር አያውቁም ነበር።
እነርሱንም ተቈጣኋቸው፤ ረገምኋቸውም፤ ከእነርሱም ዐያሌዎቹን መታሁ፤ ጠጕራቸውንም ነጨሁ፤ እንዲህም ብዬ በእግዚአብሔር አማልኋቸው፥ “ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን ለወንዶች ልጆቻቸው አትስጡ፤ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ለወንዶች ልጆቻችሁ አትውሰዱ።
የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን በዚህ ነገር ኀጢአት አድርጎ የለምን? በብዙ አሕዛብም መካከል እንደ እርሱ ያለ ንጉሥ አልነበረም፤ በአምላኩም ዘንድ የተወደደ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ አንግሦት ነበር፤ እርሱንም እንኳ እንግዶች ሴቶች አሳቱት።
እንዲሁ እንግዲህ ይህን ሁሉ ታላቅ ክፋት ስትሠሩ፥ እንግዶችንም ሴቶች በማግባት አምላካችንን ስትበድሉ አንስማባችሁ።”
ከዋነኛውም ካህን ከኤልያሴብ ልጅ ከዮዳሔ ልጆች አንዱ ለሐሮናዊው ለሰንባላጥ አማች ነበረ፤ ከእኔም ዘንድ አባረርሁት።
“አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ክህነትን የክህነትንና የሌዋውያንንም ቃል ኪዳን ስላፈረሱ አስባቸው።”
ከእንግዳ ነገርም ሁሉ አነጻኋቸው፤ ለካህናቱና ለሌዋውያኑም ለእያንዳንዳቸው በየሰሞናቸው፥
በየጊዜውም ዕንጨት ለሚሸከሙ ሰዎች ቍርባን፥ ለበኵራቱም ሥርዐት አደረግሁ። “አምላካችን ሆይ፥ በመልካም አስበኝ።”
